source.note: Derived: the weapon has no charge of its own; the Quantum time to empty counts from the first shot

catalyst.name: Supercharged Magazine, Coldheart Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Passively grants 20 Stability and 20 Reload Speed.
(Yes, these are the same stats that are set to 100 when at 100% Fusion Energy)
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while Amplified.
Activating Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.
